observations: Both accepted runs used new foreground tabs and sent all 53505 source characters in 38 real HTTP200 requests; no warm/cache repeat was requested.
Next visible requestAnimationFrame is an approximation, not an OS paint timestamp. Initial viewport targets remain frozen before insertion.
Historical 7.704s first-screen measurement used a different definition/background tab and is not a like-for-like first-screen speed ratio.
Connection setup is included. The two accepted first requests report 1.865s and 1.911s connect time including TLS; no hidden pretranslation.
Upstream caching, quota windows and load cannot be controlled. This is the fastest configuration that passed this local bounded investigation, not a proof of global optimum.
The rejected 8/100 trial is partial, has no fullDoneMs, and its submitted char count must not be treated as successful input.
The failed harness lateRequestCount default was not used as evidence; requests after the actual 429 response were independently recounted.
A 429 stopped the failed trial immediately; its local cooldown was allowed to expire naturally before a changed policy was deployed. No identity/IP rotation or automatic retries.
Different response fingerprints across independent network runs are allowed; response count, source mapping and nonempty output are validated per run.
